about_short_description.short_description: Fleetworks offers commercial fleet maintenance, mobile fleet services, roadside & onsite assistance, towing, and equipment hauling services.

product.name: Fleet Maintenance
product.description: Service to maintain and repair commercial vehicle fleets to ensure operational readiness and safety.

product.name: Mobile Mechanic Service
product.description: On-site heavy-duty diesel vehicle repair service within a 50-mile radius of Oakland or Santa Fe Springs, CA.

product.name: Roadside Assistance
product.description: Emergency repair service for heavy-duty trucks within a 50-mile radius of Santa Fe Springs, CA, available 6 am to 6 pm.

product.name: Truck Towing
product.description: Heavy-duty truck towing service based in Santa Fe Springs, CA, for vehicles that cannot be repaired on-site.

product.name: Equipment Hauling
product.description: Transportation service for heavy equipment and machinery in Oakland and Santa Fe Springs, CA.

product.name: Truck Differential Repair & Service
product.description: Repair and maintenance of heavy-duty truck differential systems to ensure proper driveline function.
